function.name: list_cart
function.description: List carts in descending update time, with optional pagination by skip/take.

skip.description: Nonnegative integer offset, default 0. Negative values are treated as 0. For the next page, add the number of returned items to skip.

take.description: Nonnegative integer result limit. Omitted or null uses 20. Zero returns no items; negative values are treated as 0.

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox name. Executes the operation in that sandbox site when provided.
